extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: An Obsidian plugin that puts a clear, always-visible banner at the top of any note that has a tag you choose.
motivation: The author wanted a more visual way to distinguish notes drafted by AI from notes they had personally worked on.
problem: Standard tags are not visually prominent enough to immediately signal the status or origin of a note.
summary: A plugin that displays a configurable, always-visible warning banner at the top of any note containing a specific tag.
